integration_summary.principal_and_acdt: Pinned Ed25519 charter verification at startup; G_eff intersection; monotonic rem_depth; USER_DECIDES ephemeral grants; aud and cnf.jkt binding.
integration_summary.dpop_and_idempotency: ES256 DPoP htm/htu/iat/jti/ath checks; atomic replay reservations; idempotency conflict detection; NONE memory store and SQLite WAL otherwise; no locks across adapter I/O.
integration_summary.ingress_and_csg: Default unknown_taint, invalid-label denial, attested provenance, and pre-adapter DENY_COMPOSITE_EGRESS for restricted synthesis to shared destinations.
integration_summary.revocation_and_rrta: Pre-dispatch revocation, cancellation/status hooks, CANCELLED/COMMITTED/UNKNOWN reconciliation, deferred recovery commits, and zero-disclosure user:direct_support_stream responses.
integration_summary.retention: NONE memory-only; PASSIVE PII stage plus k>=10 rolling 24-hour cohort and aggregate-only events; local auto-drop; ACTIVE/EXPLICIT encrypted traces; downgrade purge.
